LanguageData.LP_WS_CopySpell1.label: copy spell (circle 1)
LanguageData.LP_WS_CopySpell1.description: A wizard copies a circle 1 spellbook page (or a true seeing scroll → detect magic) into their spellbook: 50 silver, 2 hours. Success 60% + Intelligence modifier × 5% (up to 95%); Order of Scribes pays half (half the silver refunded on completion) with +15% success. Failure only loses the materials; materials are refunded if you already know the spell or can't cast that circle yet. Only wizards can do it.
LanguageData.LP_WS_CopySpell2.label: copy spell (circle 2)
LanguageData.LP_WS_CopySpell2.description: A wizard copies a circle 2 spellbook page (or a flesh to stone scroll → hold person) into their spellbook: 100 silver, 4 hours. Success 60% + Intelligence modifier × 5% (up to 95%); Order of Scribes pays half with +15% success. Failure only loses the materials. From wizard level 3.
LanguageData.LP_WS_CopySpell3.label: copy spell (circle 3)
LanguageData.LP_WS_CopySpell3.description: A wizard copies a circle 3 spellbook page (or a fear gaze scroll → fear, a protection from evil scroll → magic circle, a necrotic blast scroll → vampiric touch) into their spellbook: 150 silver, 6 hours. Success 60% + Intelligence modifier × 5% (up to 95%); Order of Scribes pays half with +15% success. Failure only loses the materials. From wizard level 5.
